node.statement: Universal constant and radius ledger. Let L,e_env; C_co,e_co; C_proj,e_proj; C_np,e_np; C_pair,e_pair; and D_1,e_1 be the universal witnesses supplied respectively by lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope, lem-compcb-single-compression-transfer, lem-stage1-rectified-nontrivial-projection, lem-stage1-original-complementary-pair, lem-stage1-fresh-two-point-inclusion, and lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement. Set K_1:=max{1,L,c_0^cb,C_proj*L,C_np*L,C_pair*L,C_co*(c_0^cb+1)} and e_call_1:=min{e_env,e_co/(c_0^cb+1),e_proj/L,e_np/L,e_pair/L,e_1/K_1}. These are positive universal constants; K_1>=1, K_1*e_call_1<=e_1, and for 0<=epsilon<=e_call_1 every displayed prerequisite inequality holds: epsilon<=e_env, (c_0^cb+1)*epsilon<=e_co, L*epsilon<=e_proj,e_np,e_pair, and t_1:=K_1*epsilon<=e_1.
